name: Zhongshan Broad-Ocean Motor Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhongshan Broad-Ocean Motor Co., Ltd. engages in the motor systems business in China. The company offers building and home appliances motors, new energy vehicle powertrain systems, and vehicle rotating electrical appliances. The company also provides motors for household/commercial air conditioners, building ventilation equipment, kitchen appliances, automatic garage doors, and water pumps; compressor motors for commercial air conditioners; fan systems for heating/ventilation systems and air conditioning equipment; energy vehicle drive motors, controllers and electric drive assembly systems, range extender generators, and BSG motor systems; and vehicle rotating electrical appliances.
